title: Creatio Review (2026)
intro: No-code CRM and workflow platform with Growth/Enterprise per-user plans and Unlimited organization pricing. This review covers verified 2026 pricing, core CRM capabilities, limitations, and who should buy — based on official first-party sources.
summary: Creatio scores reflect first-party research — not hands-on product testing.
verdict: Creatio is compelling when no-code workflow/CRM composition matters more than a simple pipeline tool. Budget for modules and the $10k/year minimum. Based on first-party research — not hands-on testing.

criterionAssessments.rationale: No-code power helps builders, but platform breadth raises the learning curve versus simple CRMs.
Sales module pipelines/deals are first-class when Sales is licensed.
Workflow/no-code automation is a defining Creatio strength.
Solid CRM email/marketing module options; module packaging adds cost.
Capable platform analytics for mid-market process apps.
No-code customization and process design are core differentiators.
Integration story is strong for a platform CRM; confirm connectors for your stack.
Platform + module packaging and process design imply real admin/builder ownership.
Growth/Enterprise/Unlimited path plus min purchase supports serious mid-market deployments.
$40 Growth entry is fair for a platform, but modules (+$15) and $10k/year minimum shape true TCO.

bestFor: Mid-market teams needing no-code CRM + workflows
Buyers composing Sales with Marketing/Service modules
notIdealFor: Micro teams under annual minimum spend
pros: No-code workflow and process design is a first-class Creatio strength, not a bolt-on
Sales, Marketing, and Service modules can be composed instead of buying a single rigid CRM SKU
Growth and Enterprise list prices are published — easier to model than contact-sales-only suites
Customization depth suits mid-market process apps that have outgrown a simple pipeline CRM
cons: A $10,000 per year minimum spend prices out micro teams and free-CRM seekers
Sales, Marketing, and Service module add-ons raise TCO beyond the platform tile
Heavier to administer than an SMB pipeline CRM such as a simple HubSpot or Pipedrive motion
Builders need process-design skill; this is not a next-day shared spreadsheet replacement
pricingSummary: Growth $40/user/mo platform, Enterprise $75; Sales/Marketing/Service +$15 each; Unlimited custom; $10,000/year minimum. USD.
limitations: Confirm live Creatio checkout; packaging can change.
whoShouldChoose: Choose Creatio when it matches your CRM buying criteria above.
whoShouldConsiderAlternatives: Consider alternatives like salesforce, hubspot, dynamics-365 if fit is weak.
